title: Defensive Parsing
prompt: Implement parse_response(status, body) where body is bytes: 204 → {}; non-JSON body → raise ApiError('non-JSON response'); status >= 400 → raise ApiError containing the status; else return parsed JSON.

tests.name: happy path parses
tests.code:
assert parse_response(200, b'{"a": 1}') == {'a': 1}
assert parse_response(204, b'') == {}

tests.name: garbage body raises
tests.hint: Decode before use — HTML where JSON was promised is an error.

tests.name: error status raises with code
tests.hint: 4xx/5xx must raise even when the body is valid JSON.
